title: InputNumber
description: Enter a number within certain range with the mouse or keyboard.
whenToUse: When a numeric value needs to be provided.

examples.name: Basic
Sizes
examples.description: There are three sizes available to a numeric input box. By default, the size is `32px`. The two additional sizes are `large` and `small` which means `40px` and `24px`, respectively.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Click the button to toggle between available and disabled states.

examples.name: High precision decimals
examples.description: Use `stringMode` to support high precision decimals support. `onChange` will return string value instead. You need polyfill of BigInt if browser not support.

examples.name: Formatter
examples.description: Display value within it's situation with `formatter`, and we usually use `parser` at the same time.

examples.name: Keyboard
Wheel
Variants
examples.description: Variants of InputNumber, there are four variants: `outlined` `filled` `borderless` and `underlined`.

examples.name: Spinner
Out of range
examples.description: Show warning style when `value` is out of range by control.

examples.name: Prefix / Suffix
examples.description: Add a prefix or suffix inside input.

examples.name: Status
examples.description: Add status to InputNumber with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.

examples.name: Focus
Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of the InputNumber by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
